mostWorthwhile.text: Building the turning and weighted sensors was worthwhile because the pictures showed how fluid or a weighted layer bends sensory hairs in different situations.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the weighted sensors was initially confusing: the separate balance nerves had disappeared, so it was not clear from the board how to proceed.

surprise.text: Inspecting the weighted sensors automatically joined them to the turning sensors, giving both incoming nerve fibres.

arbitrary.text: That connection felt a little arbitrary beforehand; I followed the compatibility hint rather than understanding from the board how the weighted sensors would acquire nerve fibres.

continue.text: I would continue to another chapter: seeing how the sensors connect to eye movement and posture was interesting, though I would hope the connections stay clear.
